baseline.name: Compare every value with every other value
baseline.approach: For each element, count how many of the other n-1 values are smaller.
baseline.space: O(1) auxiliary, excluding the n-result array

archived.name: Fixed-domain frequencies and prefix counts
archived.time: O(n+U), where n=numsSize and U=101 buckets; O(n) for this fixed domain
archived.space: O(U) auxiliary bucket storage and O(n) returned result; O(1) auxiliary for fixed U=101

why: The small 0..100 domain lets one frequency summary answer every strict-smaller query.
quantitative_comparison: The baseline makes n(n-1) ordered value comparisons when self-pairs are skipped. The archive performs n frequency increments, a U=101 bucket sweep and n answer lookups. This is a bounded-domain work model; different operation costs prevent a fixed runtime-factor claim.
tradeoffs: Adds 101 counters and depends on all input values fitting 0..100. Out-of-range input indexes outside the bucket array, and result allocation is unchecked.
evidence_basis: Static source inspection and stated algorithm work/storage model. Comparator is an analytical alternative, not an implemented or timed benchmark. Historical platform acceptance is separate from current local validation.
